 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League C - Game Week 6 Nov 16, 2026 - 08:00 Torsvoellur Stadium Faroe Islands host Moldova at the Torsvoellur Stadium in Torshavn in a UEFA Nations League C Group 3 fixture with real implications for the final standings.
 Eydun Klakstein's Faroe Islands side have been the draw specialists of the group, failing to win any of their last five matches across all competitions. Their most recent outing ended 2-2 against Slovakia, a result that typifies a campaign built on resilience rather than results.
 Moldova arrive in better shape. Lilian Popescu's side beat Kazakhstan 2-1 in their most recent match and have won two of their last five outings, giving them genuine momentum heading into this trip to Torshavn.
 The two sides met earlier in this Nations League cycle, playing out a 1-1 draw in Chisinau. Moldova will be looking to go one better on the road, while the Faroe Islands will back their home crowd to help them find a first win of the campaign.
 In the group standings, Moldova sit second while the Faroe Islands are third, making this a direct contest that could shape the final table before the group stage concludes.
